source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: When a ranged attack targets a visible unit with at least one model at ground level, improve that attack’s BS by 1 if either condition holds: the attacker stands on terrain whose section there is 3" high or more, or the attacker is a TOWERING model and the target is within 12". Examples: unit A, entirely on terrain at least 3" high, gains the bonus against a target with models at ground level; model B is at ground level but TOWERING, and its target is within 12" with models at ground level, so it gains the bonus as well.
